items.title: OpenAI 測試代理入侵 Hugging Face，四日半執行逾萬七個自主行動
items.title_en: OpenAI Rogue Agent Breached Hugging Face, Executing 17,600+ Autonomous Actions

items.summary_en: OpenAI confirmed Sora's closure; the API terminates Sep 24. Kling AI, Runway, and Google Veo 3 are capturing displaced users. OpenAI's next-gen video model 'Spud' is expected before end of 2026.
items.why: ①Sora退場令AI視頻工具選型需即時更新，9月前完成遷移

items.summary_en: OpenAI's GPT Transcribe achieves 3.31% word error rate (0.7pp better than its predecessor), adds keyword hints and multilingual support, priced 25% lower at $4.50 per 1,000 minutes.
